audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-5 were scored as Skill/Akali in both layers while every one of those rows' own 'why' text says Kennen wins them ('you own the wave here', 'she still can't all-in you safely'), and the packet levelChart scores rows 0-3 as Kennen.
audit.why: Akali has no Twilight Shroud at level 1, Kennen's Thundering Shuriken out-ranges Five Point Strike (950 vs 550), and her Shroud is a 20s cooldown at rank 1 so it cannot cover every last-hit step-up. Both layers already agreed with each other, so the fix is a matched flip of rows 0-3, not a one-sided edit.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 set to Kennen at 6/10 in both phases[N].side and win[N]. Rows 4-6 left as-is: they match the packet and the content prose about her R and 2-item takeover.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in the full layer; breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.mid gave only 'when it is down'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16, Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, Perfect Execution 120/90/60, Kennen's Slicing Maelstrom a flat 120. The 20s Shroud at rank 1 is the number that makes 'poke her step-ups' actionable.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around real numbers; breakdown.mid and dosFull[2].d now carry the 20s Shroud.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer named only Twilight Shroud — never Assassin's Mark, Five Point Strike, Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution — and used male pronouns for Akali throughout. The Assassin's Mark ring tell was absent (missingInteractions).
audit.why: Riot's text for Assassin's Mark: dealing spell damage rings the target, and exiting that ring empowers her next attack with bonus range and damage. The step-out is the visible tell. Five Point Strike is a 1.5s cooldown gated by energy, not time, which is why 'wait out her Q' is wrong advice.
audit.corrected: report[5].t states the Assassin's Mark ring tell; dontsFull[1].d states Q's 1.5s energy-gated cooldown; tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d now name the real abilities and use her pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding and breakdown.late all referred to Akali as 'he'.
audit.why: Wrong-gender pronouns read as template filler and undercut trust in the rest of the page.

edits.before: Shuriken Akali's last-hits, weave an AA mark, and stun on the third proc when his answer is down.
edits.after: Thundering Shuriken her last-hits, weave an Electrical Surge mark, stun on the third while Shroud is down.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Poke when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1, 16s maxed — untargetable inside, so poke the moment it drops. - Shuriken Flip: 16s, her escape and her re-entry. - Perfect Execution: 120s at rank 1. - Slicing Maelstrom: 120s flat, kill windows only.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Twilight Shroud: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Twilight Shroud's 20s: while it is down, run the full mark chain; while it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.

edits.after: If Akali gets a kill, stop forcing and respect Twilight Shroud. Two kills: farm safe and call for jungle cover. If she snowballs, play for picks with your team — not solo redemption.

notes: Packet suspectName 'Throw Thundering Shuriken' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Thundering Shuriken is Kennen's real Q name. Akali's Assassin's Mark carries a derived 'autoReset' flag that Riot's own description does not state (it describes an empowered next attack with bonus range on ring exit), so the page describes the ring exit rather than asserting an attack reset. The content layer was already accurate and specific and was left alone apart from the four level-chart rows, which were flipped in matched pairs with the full layer. Row 6 was left as Akali in both layers: the packet says Kennen there, but content.late and spikes[3] both describe a 2-item Akali takeover and the two layers already agree.
